valuation_template_rationale: Enphase is a solar-equipment manufacturer whose earnings depend on policy-timed demand, tariffs, channel inventory, manufacturing credits and product mix; no specialized repository template captures those interacting drivers, so a normalized multi-scenario DCF is required once supportable inputs exist.
rating_change_conditions: Establish a scenario-complete normalized DCF only after core sell-through can be separated from safe-harbor shipments, nonrecurring tariff refunds and manufacturing credits can be normalized, durable post-policy margins and free cash flow can be bounded, and diluted shares are current; downgrade on continuing U.S. contraction, failed safe-harbor conversion, inventory discounting, tariff or warranty pressure, or weak capital allocation.
